measurements.statement: white cherry-blossom branches dominate the left two-thirds, dense hugging the left edge and thinning to isolated sprigs toward center-right
measurements.value: ≈60% of frame, densest on left third

measurements.how_measured: compared edge definition of blossom clusters and thin branches against edges of tower windows and rooflines
measurements.statement: foreground blossoms on the left are relatively sharp with branch detail while building and tower on right and bottom are heavily blurred
measurements.value: sharp vs blurred split ≈ left 2/3 sharp : right 1/3 + lower half blurred

measurements.how_measured: traced contiguous cloud-free sky area and estimated its share of the frame
measurements.statement: empty pale blue sky sits in top-center to top-right with no clouds, the only large empty background

measurements.how_measured: counted distinct vertical structures and measured its horizontal extent against total frame width
measurements.statement: one out-of-focus historic tower hugs the extreme right edge running full height top to bottom
measurements.value: count 1, width ≈20% of frame, hugging right edge

measurements.how_measured: scanned the frame for distinct hues and any vivid saturated area and estimated coverage
measurements.statement: palette is limited to near-white blossoms, pale cyan-blue sky, and dark muted warm-gray building with no saturated accent

hypotheses.statement: Hierarchy is carried by focus rather than size: sharp blossoms feel intimate and primary while the large but blurred tower stays as quiet context.
A diagonal branching rhythm moves from dense mass hugging the left edge to thin isolated sprigs reaching center-right, creating left-to-right movement into open sky.
A soft high-key spring mood comes from dominant near-white and pale blue against a dark muted anchor at bottom-right, with no saturated color to break calm.

relations.rule: Keep primary subject sharp in foreground occupying ~60% on one side while keeping contextual architecture heavily blurred and subordinate
Arrange dense mass on one edge thinning to isolated sprigs reaching into ~1/3 empty sky void
Limit palette to ~3 desaturated hues with near-white dominant and zero saturated accent coverage

fragile_if_changed: Bringing the background building and tower into sharp equal focus with the blossoms would destroy the soft foreground-intimacy and depth contrast that define the image.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'overall palette'
